chapter: New York with Lester Young and Coleman Hawkins
title: Utility pianist on 52nd Street
summary: On 52nd Street he played with Hot Lips Page, Roy Eldridge and others, a utility pianist, and met Coleman Hawkins.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well, who became your special friends in New York at that time?

I met a lot of people in the business, you know many -- all the musicians, as I said, that I played with, I got to know them. I played with Hot Lips Page and Roy Eldridge and oh, many other musicians played there. Don
In fact I was more or less a utility piano player on 52nd Street.
On 52nd Street was so busy then.
So big. And of course a pianist who could fall right in with everybody, you know --
In fact this is when I met Coleman Hawkins during that period.
I was just going to say.
Later on, yes. And to me -- as I said, my whole life was spent studying music with these great artists, and I was learning all the time.
